title: M-absolutely convergent integer series of integer multiplicity currents (Simon 3.13)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, T_r ∈ D_n(U) (r ∈ ℕ) integer multiplicity currents and c_r ∈ ℤ such that Σ_r |c_r| M_W(T_r) < ∞ for every open W ⊂⊂ U. Then there is S ∈ D_n(U) such that for every ω ∈ D^n(U) the series Σ_r c_r T_r(ω) has (unconditional) sum S(ω), M_W(S) ≤ Σ_r |c_r| M_W(T_r) for every set W ⊆ ℝ^P, and S is integer multiplicity.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (T : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U n) (c : ℕ → ℤ), (∀ r, IsIntegerMultiplicity (T r)) → (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → (∑' r, ((c r).natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) * (T r).massOn W) < ∞) → ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn U n, (∀ ω, HasSum (fun r => (c r : ℝ) * T r ω) (S ω)) ∧ (∀ W, S.massOn W ≤ ∑' r, ((c r).natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) * (T r).massOn W) ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity S
